text:
sara: quick design ask — console chart in Metrics -> Overview: with 3+ series the minor ticks + gridlines feel noisy, and legend spacing pushes the series labels off small screens. want thoughts on a compact affordance? devin: +1 noticed this in the support dashboard too. can we collapse minor ticks into an optional "compact" mode? maybe toggle per-panel. :thinking_face: alex: i like a mode, but let's be careful with keyboard/screen-reader access. if we hide ticks visually we still need accessible markers or descriptions. mike: proposal: default for 'monitoring' dashboards = raw (no smoothing, visible minor ticks), default for 'trend' dashboards = smoothing on and minor ticks reduced. toggle persisted per-route. sara: agreed re: defaults. also UI suggestion for legend: split into primary metrics (bold) + secondary (muted) with a chevron to expand the full list. keeps density down but still discoverable. rachel: ergonomics note — on touch, small legend tap targets cause fat-finger issues. we should increase hit area and make long-press show full name + raw value. devin: for outliers: rather than clipping, what about 'peripheral dimming' to reduce visual weight of single spikes? keeps data honest but de-emphasizes noise. alex: accessibility nit for screen readers: include an aria-describedby summarizing visible ranges and last point. e.g. code sample to include in chart wrapper: ```
Latest: 122ms at 09:42. Range: 10ms–2.4s. 3 series visible.
``` mike: love the aria example. also copy tweak: use SI prefixes in axis (e.g., 1.2M) but show expanded unit on hover/focus like "1.2M (million)" — helps clarity for new users. sara: final question — smoothing algorithm: moving-average feels too laggy for short windows. prefer exponential smoothing with adjustable window. devs: can we add a small inline control: "Smoothing: Off / EMA 0.3 / EMA 0.6 / Custom"? devin: will prototype compact tick mode + legend split. i'll post a quick mock tomorrow. :thumbsup: design-bot: reminder — please add any accessibility changes to the a11y checklist ticket #A11Y-87 referencing this thread. sara: thanks all — feel free to ping me on the mock.
